correctness.rationale: On the four-triangle conforming mesh, each triangle has area 1/4 and the center hat has mass 1/6, stiffness 4, eigenvalue 24. Substitution in the exact published Picard update yields x_next=(g+2)/(2(1+x^2)). Its fixed point solves the strictly increasing cubic x+x^3=(g+2)/2. The exact factorization of the second iterate and monotone convergence of its even subsequence prove the if-and-only-if g=2 transition. Exact cycle roots, residuals, multiplier and unbounded upper-phase ratio follow algebraically; checker.py independently verifies the critical identities.

value.rationale: This is a complete sharp feasibility classification for an actual conforming P1 nonlinear time-step solver, not a normalized scalar exercise: the exact implicit stage remains uniquely solvable while the published undamped Picard update undergoes an attracting flip. The explicit threshold separates solvable-but-nonconvergent stages from globally convergent ones, identifies an exact nonzero residual and unbounded upper-phase error as load increases, and motivates nonlinear residual monitoring, damping, or solver substitution at larger forcing/time steps. The narrow one-node benchmark is self-contained and directly reproducible.
